steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the arms race and glorification of military power  
2. Alliance systems – binding treaties (e.g., Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance)  
3. Nationalism – intense national pride and ethnic tensions across Europe
